svg.title: Dog-Ear assistant with open models: model-neutral gateway and hosting options
svg.desc: The browser keeps the same assistant panel and tool runner, and can optionally run a small model, Whisper and Tesseract on the device. A Supabase Edge Function acts as a model-neutral gateway: a command parser handles simple commands without a model, a router picks a small or large model, and adapters speak the Anthropic Messages API or the OpenAI-compatible API. Backends are Claude, hosted open-model APIs, or your own GPU server running vLLM, Whisper and an OCR model. Every turn is traced and scored against an evaluation set.
svg.text: Open models: a model-neutral gateway and where to host them
RFC 0002 · Hybrid design. The browser and tools stay the same; the gateway decides which model answers, so models can be swapped or mixed.
in CI and on every turn

vLLM, open 8B model, one 24 GB GPU

A self-hosted model runs on vLLM, reachable only

Tesseract run in the browser, offline.
